item.title: AI-ready colocation: How providers are redesigning for enterprise AI
item.description: #AI is reshaping the expectations placed on #datacenters, and the industry is only at the beginning of that curve. As enterprises move deeper into accelerated computing, the environments supporting these workloads will need to evolve at the same pace.

item.title: East Ventures stays “cautiously optimistic” on Southeast Asia tech ecosystem in 2026
item.description: We talked to Roderick Purwana, Managing Partner at East Ventures to learn more about the firm’s development in 2025 and its plans and aspirations for 2026. He also shared his views on the outlook of tech ecosystem in Southeast Asia in 2026.

item.title: PropertyGuru appoints Yi-Wei Ang as Chief Product & Technology Officer
item.description: PropertyGuru Group, a Singapore-based property technology company, announced Monday the appointment of Yi-Wei Ang as Chief Product & Technology Officer.

item.title: Abu Dhabi’s G42 partners Vietnamese Consortium to form $1B AI data center in Vietnam
item.description: G42, the Abu Dhabi-based technology holding group, and a consortium comprising the FPT Corporation and the Viet Thai Group, have signed a framework cooperation agreement to develop $1 billion sovereign artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities and cloud infrastructure across Vietnam.

item.title: Microsoft launches AI QuickStart Program in Singapore with support from IMDA and UOB
item.description: Global technology firm Microsoft has launched the AI QuickStart program, a new initiative to help digitally mature enterprises – including small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) as well as large enterprises – known as Digital Leaders to rapidly deploy practical, enterprise-ready artificial intelligence (AI) solutions in Singapore.

item.title: Nexus Global Payments appoints PayNet and NETS as technical operator
item.description: Nexus Global Payments (NGP) has appointed Payments Network Malaysia (PayNet) and Network for Electronic Transfers Singapore (NETS) joint venture as the Nexus Technical Operator (NTO).

item.title: Why AI needs a doctor’s hand to build reliable healthcare technology
item.description: The next generation of #AI in #healthcare will not be defined by faster models or bigger datasets, but by the trust they can earn.

item.title: Malaysia’s Tech Minister shares plans as SE Asia’s tech adoption accelerates across sectors [Q&A]
item.description: We talked to Chang Lih Kang, Malaysia’s Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation, to learn more about the ministry's achievements in 2025 and its plans and aspirations for 2026. He also shared his views on the outlook of tech ecosystem in Malaysia and Southeast Asia for 2026.

item.title: GoTo partners MRT Jakarta to launch TOD model integrating public transportation with digital platforms
item.description: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk, Indonesia's largest digital ecosystem, in collaboration with PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda), has launched Blok M Hub Gojek, a Transit Oriented Development (TOD) model integrating public transportation with digital platforms.

item.title: Malaysia’s automotive aftersales platform ServAuto raises new funding led by Vynn Capital
item.description: ServAuto, a Malaysia-based automotive aftersales platform, announced Tuesday that it has secured new funding, bringing its total capital raised to close to $6 million to date.
